data.variant: UCI original processed Cleveland (303 records verified)

configuration.selection: Highest training repeated-CV mean ROC-AUC for the base classifier; ties: recall, precision, then name. Probability method selected separately with nested training-only CV. Neither holdout nor external results select models or calibrators.

limitations: Small historical observational cohorts; no prospective or clinical validation.
Cleveland holdout has been inspected previously; new results are an audit, not a new final benchmark.
Repeated folds are correlated; fold SD is not a confidence interval.
Intervals condition on a fixed model and do not include training/selection or site uncertainty.
Calibration is selected on training folds only; probability outputs are not clinically validated risk scores.
Demographic slices are small and descriptive; no fairness or equivalence claim.
External feature missingness and hospital selection can materially bias transfer results.
Do not tune using viewed holdout, subgroup, importance or external diagnostics.

calibration.selection_rule: Retain sigmoid only if paired outer-CV mean Brier improves by >=0.002 and mean log loss also decreases; otherwise retain raw. All fitting and selection use training only.
calibration.caution: Brier and log loss measure overall probability quality, not calibration alone. Reliability curves use per-observation mean repeated out-of-fold probabilities; they describe CV ensembles, not the final fitted model. Bin intervals are descriptive and ignore training dependence. Folds/repeats are correlated; score SD is not a confidence interval. Isotonic omitted because the calibration sample is small. Calibration is not clinical validation.

uncertainty.caution: Conditional on this fixed fitted model and sampled cohort. Does not include training, selection, site, or measurement uncertainty. AUC bootstrap preserves observed class counts. Wilson precision/accuracy can change with prevalence. Intervals do not establish clinical safety.
